rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a story or film that continues an earlier one.

example.english: I heard the sequel to this film will be released next year.
example.traditional: 呢套戲嘅續集聽講下年上映。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zuk6 zaap6 teng1 gong2 haa6 nin4 soeng5 jing2

rows.note: Use this when the sequel is being identified as the second numbered installment of a film or series.

example.english: The sequel, the second installment, is much more fast-paced than the first one.
example.traditional: 呢套劇第二集比第一集緊湊好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 kek6 dai6 ji6 zaap6 bei2 dai6 jat1 zaap6 gan2 cau3 hou2 do1
